Method of Attack: Remote execution of arbitrary PHP code via Drupal core RESTful Web Services module when PATCH or POST requests are allowed and some field types fail to sanitize data from non-form sources
Attack Vector: Exploitation of RESTful Web Services (rest) module in Drupal 8 core with enabled PATCH or POST requests; also JSON:API in Drupal 8, Services or RESTful Web Services in Drupal 7
